doc.title: Bobby Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997

title: Public school and college instruction
summary: Gordon had school instruction and a couple of years of college, learning harmony and theory.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: And did you get instruction in public school?
Yes I did. In public school and then I went for a couple of years to college, and then learned a little bit about harmony and theory and things like that.
